components.name: NuLayout
components.description: App shell: sidebar (or top nav), navbar, content and footer, with every AdminLTE layout option as a prop.

props.name: menu
props.description: Menu definition (NuMenuItem[]); the same array drives sidebar, top nav and command palette.

props.name: brand
props.description: Product name shown next to the logo.

props.name: logo
props.description: Logo image URL. Without one: the Nusa Admin mark for the default brand, otherwise the first letter of `brand`.

props.name: layout
props.description: `top-nav` puts the menu in the navbar on desktop (the sidebar remains the mobile drawer).

props.name: rtl
props.description: Right-to-left layout (sets `dir` on <html> while this layout is mounted).

props.name: sidebarSearch
props.description: Filter box at the top of the sidebar menu.

props.name: customizer
props.description: Show the floating theme customizer button.

examples.code:
<NuLayout :menu="menu" brand="My App" sidebar-search fullscreen-toggle>
  <template #navbar-end><!-- notifications, language… --></template>
  <template #navbar-user><!-- account dropdown --></template>
  <RouterView />
  <template #footer>© My App</template>
</NuLayout>

components.name: NuStatCard
components.description: KPI tile: label, value, icon, delta vs a period, optional sparkline in the default slot.

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon component (any Vue component, e.g. from lucide-vue-next).

props.name: delta
props.description: Signed change in percent, e.g. 12.5 or -3.2.

props.name: deltaLabel
props.description: What the delta compares against, e.g. "vs last month".

components.name: NuTable
components.description: Data table: search, sort, pagination, cell slots, row selection with bulk actions, CSV export, server mode. Each column can be customised with a `cell-<key>` slot receiving `{ row, value }`.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column definitions: key, label, sortable, align, width, format.

props.name: rows
props.description: Row objects (in server mode: just the current page).

props.name: rowKey
props.description: Property used as the row key (required for `selectable`). Falls back to the row index.

props.name: selectable
props.description: Checkbox column; bind the chosen row keys with `v-model:selected`.

props.name: exportable
props.description: "Export CSV" button. Pass a string to set the file name. Exports every filtered row, sorted.

props.name: manual
props.description: Server mode: the table doesn't search, sort or paginate `rows` itself. Bind `v-model:search`, `v-model:sort` and `v-model:page`, load the page yourself and pass `total`.

props.name: total
props.description: Total row count in server mode.

examples.code:
<NuTable :columns="columns" :rows="orders.slice(0, 7)" row-key="id" :page-size="0">
  <template #cell-status="{ row }"><NuBadge :color="statusColor[row.status as Order['status']]">{{ row.status }}</NuBadge></template>
</NuTable>

components.name: NuTransfer

components.name: NuFileUpload

examples.code: <NuFileUpload v-model="form.values.files" multiple label="Attach files" hint="Max 25 MB in total" />
<NuFileUpload v-model="files" multiple hint="Any file type, several at once" />

components.name: NuRating

<NuRating v-model="score" />

components.name: NuChart
components.description: Dependency-free SVG line, area or bar chart with legend and hover tooltip.

props.name: labels
props.description: One label per data point (x axis).

props.name: format
props.description: Format y-axis ticks and tooltip values.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible summary of what the chart shows.

examples.code:
<NuChart
  type="area"
  :labels="months"
  :series="[{ name: 'Revenue', data: revenue }, { name: 'Expenses', data: expenses }]"
  :format="(v) => `$${(v / 1000).toFixed(0)}K`"
  label="Revenue versus expenses over the last 12 months"
/>
<NuChart type="area" :labels="months" :series="[{ name: 'Revenue', data: revenue }, { name: 'Expenses', data: expenses }]" :format="(v) => `$${(v / 1000).toFixed(0)}K`" :height="240" />

components.name: NuDonut

<NuDonut :segments="browsers" total-label="Visits" :size="150" />

components.name: NuSparkline

examples.code: <NuSparkline :data="revenue" label="Revenue, last 12 months" />
<NuSparkline :data="o.good ? [3, 4, 3, 5, 6, 7] : [6, 5, 6, 4, 3, 3]" :color="o.good ? 'var(--nu-success)' : 'var(--nu-danger)'" :height="28" :area="false" />

components.name: NuGeoMap
components.description: Choropleth map from GeoJSON features with a sequential color legend and tooltips.

props.name: keyOf
props.description: How to get a feature's key into `values`. Defaults to `properties.name`.

props.name: format
props.description: Format values in the tooltip and legend.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible summary (also provide the numbers as text elsewhere, e.g. a list or table).

props.name: exclude
props.description: Feature keys to leave out, e.g. ['Antarctica'].

examples.code: <NuGeoMap :features="shapes" :values="visitors" :exclude="['Antarctica']" :format="(v) => `${v.toLocaleString()} sessions`" label="World map of sessions by country; top countries listed beside it" />

composables.name: useTheme
composables.signature: useTheme(): { theme: { mode, resolved, primary }, setMode(mode), toggleDark(), setPrimary(color | null), setDefaults({ mode, primary }) }
composables.description: Light/dark/system mode and brand color, saved in localStorage (nu-theme).

composables.name: useLayout
composables.signature: useLayout(): { layout, toggleSidebar(), setOption(key, value), setSidebarVariant('dark' | 'light'), setDefaults(), applyDirection(rtl), isMobile() }
composables.description: Layout options (topNav, boxed, fixedNavbar, fixedSidebar, fixedFooter, collapsed, rtl), saved in localStorage (nu-layout).

composables.name: useToast
composables.signature: useToast(): { toasts, show(input, color?), success(input), error(input), warning(input), info(input), dismiss(id) }
composables.description: Fire toasts from anywhere; input is a message string or { title?, message, duration? }.

composables.name: useForm
composables.signature: useForm(initial, schema): { values, errors, touched, submitting, isValid, validate(), validateField(name), reset(next?), field(name), handleSubmit(fn) }
composables.description: Form state and validation. `v-bind="form.field('email')"` wires value, update, blur validation and error into any Nu* input.

composables.name: rules
composables.signature: rules.required(msg?) | email(msg?) | minLength(n, msg?) | maxLength(n, msg?) | min(n, msg?) | max(n, msg?) | pattern(re, msg?) | sameAs(field, msg?)
composables.description: Built-in validation rules; any (value, values) => true | message also works.

composables.name: useLocale
composables.signature: useLocale(): { locale, setLocale(code), setDefaultLocale(code), addMessages(code, messages), t(key, params?) }
composables.description: Language of built-in text (en, id, or added), saved in localStorage (nu-locale).

composables.name: useOverlay
composables.signature: useOverlay(open: Ref<boolean>, panel: Ref<HTMLElement | null>, { onEscape? })
composables.description: Focus trap, scroll lock, Escape handling and focus restore for custom dialogs.

composables.name: filterMenu
composables.description: Hide menu items (e.g. by item.meta.roles), dropping emptied groups and headers.

composables.name: toCsv / downloadText
composables.signature: toCsv(rows, columns): string; downloadText(filename, text, type?)
composables.description: CSV from table columns (labels + format) and a browser download helper.

composables.name: applyMask / unmask
composables.signature: applyMask(value, mask): string; unmask(value, mask): string
composables.description: Input masks: 9 digit, a letter, * either; other characters are literals.

composables.name: createNusaAdmin
composables.signature: createNusaAdmin({ theme?, primary?, sidebarVariant?, layout?, locale?, messages?, registerComponents? }): Plugin
composables.description: Vue plugin: applies defaults for first-time visitors and registers Nu* components globally (unless registerComponents: false).
